nodes.title: 402-First Machine Payments (Price-Before-Work Tool Purchases)
nodes.summary: Server returns an HTTP 402 price quote before doing work, and the agent pays the exact amount only if it fits its budget cap

nodes.title: Abstracted Code Representation for Review
nodes.summary: Shows reviewers pseudocode, intent summaries, and logical diffs of code changes, with drill-down to the real code to confirm the mapping

nodes.title: Action Caching & Replay Pattern
nodes.summary: Records each agent action with XPath and frame metadata so later runs replay it without LLM calls, with LLM fallback when replay fails

nodes.title: Action-Selector Pattern
nodes.summary: LLM maps user intent to a pre-approved action ID with schema-validated parameters, and tool outputs never return to the selector

nodes.title: Adaptive Sandbox Fan-Out Controller
nodes.summary: Starts a small batch of parallel sandboxes, then scales up, stops early, or refines the prompt based on early success, variance, and error signals

nodes.title: Agent Circuit Breaker
nodes.summary: Prevents agents from wasting tokens and time on repeatedly failing tools by tracking failure rates and temporarily disabling broken tool endpoints

nodes.title: Agent Modes by Model Personality
nodes.summary: Offers separate working modes, each with its own prompts, tools, UI, and expectations, tuned to one model's working style

nodes.title: Agent Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (Agent RFT)
nodes.summary: Trains model weights with reinforcement learning on real tool calls and custom graders to improve domain-specific tool use and multi-step reasoning

nodes.title: Agent SDK for Programmatic Control
nodes.summary: Exposes agent functions through an SDK and CLI so code can run the agent headless with set tools, permissions, and resource limits

nodes.title: Agent-Assisted Scaffolding
nodes.summary: Agent generates initial files, boilerplate, and directory structure from a high-level description so developers start on core logic

nodes.title: Agent-Driven Research
nodes.summary: Agent plans its own search queries, runs them across sources, reflects on gaps, and iterates until it can write a sourced report

nodes.title: Agent-First Tool Discovery
nodes.summary: Build search indexes designed for agent consumers, returning structured tool metadata ranked by agent-relevant signals instead of human SEO metrics.

nodes.title: Agent-First Tooling and Logging
nodes.summary: Designs tools and logs for agent consumption with one unified log stream, structured JSON output, and agent-aware CLI flags

nodes.title: Agent-Friendly Workflow Design
nodes.summary: Gives agents clear high-level goals, room for implementation choices, structured I/O, and plan review before execution

nodes.title: Agent-Powered Codebase Q&A / Onboarding
nodes.summary: Agent indexes the codebase with embeddings and code graphs and answers natural-language questions about where code is and how it behaves

nodes.title: Agentic Search Over Vector Embeddings
nodes.summary: Replaces vector indexes with agent-driven grep, find, and file traversal that searches current file state on demand and refines iteratively

nodes.title: AI Web Search Agent Loop
nodes.summary: Coordinator agent translates queries, spawns parallel search workers across domains and time ranges, refines iteratively, and answers with citations

nodes.title: AI-Accelerated Learning and Skill Development
nodes.summary: Uses AI assistants as tutors that explain errors and concepts, offer alternatives, and fade support as the developer gains skill

nodes.title: AI-Assisted Code Review / Verification
nodes.summary: Uses AI tools to flag issues, summarize change intent, and explain code so human reviewers focus on intent and business logic

nodes.title: Anti-Reward-Hacking Grader Design
nodes.summary: Design reward functions with multi-criteria evaluation and iterative hardening to prevent models from gaming graders, ensuring training rewards align with actual task quality.

nodes.title: Artifact-Driven Analysis Pipeline Orchestration
nodes.summary: Has an agent run independent analysis scripts, read their structured reports, and merge them into one final report or visualization

nodes.title: Asynchronous Coding Agent Pipeline
nodes.summary: Splits inference, tool execution, reward modeling, and learning into asynchronous workers linked by message queues so GPUs stay busy

nodes.title: Authenticated Authority Channel
nodes.summary: Preserve a distinguishable channel for authenticated intent so retrieved content can inform reasoning without granting itself authority.

nodes.title: Autonomous Workflow Agent Architecture
nodes.summary: Runs multi-step engineering workflows in containers with tmux sessions, adaptive monitoring, checkpoints, and context-aware error recovery

nodes.title: Background Agent with CI Feedback
nodes.summary: Runs the agent in the background on its own branch and uses CI results as feedback to patch failures until green or blocked

nodes.title: Black-Box Skill Invocation
nodes.summary: Shares skills through input and output schemas only and runs them on the provider side, so prompts and code never cross the boundary

nodes.title: Board-Mediated Async Inter-Agent Coordination
nodes.summary: Routes agent-to-agent messages through comment threads on board cards, with a prefix that creates an inbox card to notify the target agent

nodes.title: Budget-Aware Model Routing with Hard Cost Caps
nodes.summary: Routes each request to the cheapest model that meets its needs under hard cost caps, and escalates only when quality gates fail

nodes.title: Burn the Boats
nodes.summary: Removes working but obsolete features on a hard, announced deadline so the team and users move to the new approach

nodes.title: Canary Rollout and Automatic Rollback for Agent Policy Changes
nodes.summary: Ships agent policy changes to a small traffic slice first, monitors guardrail metrics, and rolls back to the last stable version automatically

nodes.title: Capability-Escrow-Receipt
nodes.summary: Binds a signed capability listing, an atomic escrow-plus-hire step, and a signed work receipt into one loop for agent-to-agent payment

nodes.title: Chain-of-Thought Monitoring & Interruption
nodes.summary: Streams agent reasoning and tool calls in real time so a human can interrupt and redirect early when the approach is wrong

nodes.title: Classify-Then-Act for Background Agents
nodes.summary: Sorts each task into has-default, needs-intent, or out-of-scope, builds only has-default work in a sandbox, and queues it for human review

nodes.title: CLI-First Skill Design
nodes.summary: Builds each skill as a standalone CLI with JSON output and exit codes so humans and agents use the same interface

nodes.title: CLI-Native Agent Orchestration
nodes.summary: Exposes agent capabilities as CLI commands with JSON output and exit codes so Makefiles, Git hooks, cron jobs, and CI can script and replay agent runs

nodes.title: Code Mode MCP Tool Interface Improvement Pattern
nodes.summary: LLMs generate TypeScript code to orchestrate MCP tools in ephemeral V8 isolates, eliminating token-heavy round-trips and enabling efficient multi-step workflows with 10x+ token savings.

nodes.title: Code-Over-API Pattern
nodes.summary: Agent writes code that calls tools and filters data inside a sandbox, so only summaries and samples return to the context window

nodes.title: Code-Then-Execute Pattern
nodes.summary: LLM writes a sandboxed program or DSL script, a static taint checker verifies data flows, and an interpreter runs it in a locked sandbox

nodes.title: Codebase Optimization for Agents
nodes.summary: Optimizes tooling, CLIs, tests, and docs for agents first, with one-command verify loops and machine-readable output, even if human DX regresses

nodes.title: Coding Agent CI Feedback Loop
nodes.summary: Agent pushes a branch, polls CI for partial failures, patches the failing files within a retry budget, and notifies when all tests pass

nodes.title: Commitment Ledger with Reality-Gated Credit
nodes.summary: Records agent promises and credits retrieved memory only after an externally verifiable outcome settles.

nodes.title: Compounding Engineering Pattern
nodes.summary: After each feature, codifies agent mistakes and learnings into CLAUDE.md, slash commands, subagents, and hooks so the next feature is easier to build

nodes.title: Conditional Parallel Tool Execution
nodes.summary: Runs a batch of tool calls in parallel when all are read-only and in sequence when any modifies state, then returns results in request order

nodes.title: Consequence-Family Coverage Audit
nodes.summary: Audit an agent's risk policy by enumerating families of consequence and asking which rule covers each, because a hand-written risk list reliably encodes one family and stays silent on the rest

nodes.title: Context Budget as a Governed Resource
nodes.summary: Measures always-loaded context per source, alerts on trend growth, and puts hard spend caps and fan-out bounds on unattended agent runs

nodes.title: Context Window Anxiety Management
nodes.summary: Enables a large context window but caps usage lower, and adds prompts that state the token budget so the model does not rush to finish

nodes.title: Context Window Auto-Compaction
nodes.summary: Catches context overflow errors, compacts and validates the transcript with a reserve token floor, and retries the request automatically

nodes.title: Context-Minimization Pattern
nodes.summary: Removes untrusted user text and tool output from context after it becomes a safe structured artifact, so later steps see only trusted data

nodes.title: Continuous Autonomous Task Loop Pattern
nodes.summary: Runs a loop where subagents pick the next task from a todo file, execute it in fresh context, commit it, and back off on rate limits

nodes.title: CriticGPT-Style Code Review
nodes.summary: Runs a specialized critic model over generated code to find bugs, security flaws, and quality issues, and feeds critical findings back for regeneration

nodes.title: Cross-Agent Lesson Sharing via Git
nodes.summary: Agents write solved problems as markdown lessons in a shared Git repo and search them before debugging, with GitHub Issues as the coordination layer

nodes.title: Cross-Cycle Consensus Relay
nodes.summary: Each loop cycle reads a structured relay document, does its work, and atomically writes back decisions, open questions, and the single next action

nodes.title: Cross-Domain Agent Conflict Resolution
nodes.summary: A coordination layer that cross-references recommendations from independent domain agents, detects conflicts on shared resources, and resolves them through policy-as-code.

nodes.title: Cross-Protocol Agent Discovery
nodes.summary: Aggregate agent metadata across fragmented registries and protocols into a unified, protocol-agnostic discovery layer.

nodes.title: Cryptographic Governance Audit Trail
nodes.summary: Middleware checks each tool call against a policy file, then signs a receipt of the action with ML-DSA and appends it to a tamper-evident chain

nodes.title: Curated Code Context Window
nodes.summary: A search subagent finds the few relevant files for a task and injects only top snippets or summaries into the main coding agent's context

nodes.title: Curated File Context Window
nodes.summary: Loads only the primary task files into the main context and has a search sub-agent rank and summarize secondary files before adding them

nodes.title: Custom Sandboxed Background Agent
nodes.summary: Builds an in-house background coding agent that runs in sandboxed dev environments, streams progress over WebSocket, and iterates on compiler and test feedback

nodes.title: Dead-Man's Switch for Scheduled Agent Jobs
nodes.summary: Each scheduled job writes a success sentinel to its log, and a separate checker files a task when the sentinel is missing or stale

nodes.title: Declarative Multi-Agent Topology Definition
nodes.summary: Define multi-agent systems declaratively in a single topology file — agents, flows, gates, hooks, group chats — then compile to platform-specific configurations for any agentic framework.

nodes.title: Democratization of Tooling via Agents
nodes.summary: Non-programmers describe a tool in natural language and iterate with an AI agent that generates and fixes the code for dashboards, scripts, or small apps

nodes.title: Denial Tracking & Permission Escalation
nodes.summary: Track repeated tool denials and auto-escalate to blanket permission prompts or fallback strategies, preventing wasted iterations in non-interactive contexts.

nodes.title: Design-Time File Partition as Concurrency Control
nodes.summary: Each task declares every path it will write; overlapping tasks get a blocking dependency so only disjoint work runs at once on a shared checkout

nodes.title: Deterministic Grader in the Loop
nodes.summary: Replace the LLM-as-judge in an agent's self-review loop with a deterministic scorer that returns the raw counts behind each sub-score, so the agent has something specific to fix.

nodes.title: Deterministic Security Scanning Build Loop
nodes.summary: Adds SAST, SCA, and secret scanners to the build target that the agent must run after each change, so scanner failures force the agent to fix the code

nodes.title: Deterministic Threat Rule Scanning
nodes.summary: Apply deterministic regex rules as a first-pass security layer to detect known threat patterns in AI agent tool calls and skill definitions.

nodes.title: Deterministic Zero-LLM Orchestration
nodes.summary: A deterministic code orchestrator splits goals, runs parallel coding agents, verifies with tests, and commits, spending no LLM tokens on coordination

nodes.title: Dev Tooling Assumptions Reset
nodes.summary: Audits dev tools for human-effort assumptions and replaces tickets, PR ceremony, and sprints with immediate agent dispatch, variations, and automated tests

nodes.title: Discrete Phase Separation
nodes.summary: Splits work into separate research, planning, and implementation conversations, each with fresh context, passing only distilled outputs between phases

nodes.title: Disposable Scaffolding Over Durable Features
nodes.summary: Treats code around the model as temporary scaffolding: build the simplest thing that works now, mark it disposable, and remove it when models improve

nodes.title: Distributed Execution with Cloud Workers
nodes.summary: Runs many agent sessions in parallel on cloud workers, each in its own git worktree, with dependency-aware scheduling, merge coordination, and approval gates

nodes.title: Dogfooding with Rapid Iteration for Agent Improvement
nodes.summary: The agent team uses its own agent for daily work, collects feedback in low-friction channels, and ships features internally first to validate or discard them

nodes.title: Dual LLM Pattern
nodes.summary: Splits work between a privileged LLM that calls tools but never sees untrusted data and a quarantined LLM that reads untrusted data but has no tools

nodes.title: Dual-Rail Message Delivery
nodes.summary: Sends every inter-agent message on two independent channels through one entry point, alerts when the rails diverge, and requires ACKs to confirm completion

nodes.title: Dual-Use Tool Design
nodes.summary: Builds each tool with one interface and implementation that both humans and agents can call, with the same output, permissions, and logs

nodes.title: Dynamic Code Injection (On-Demand File Fetch)
nodes.summary: Expands @file or /load tokens in the prompt into file contents, line ranges, or summaries so the agent sees code without manual copy and paste

nodes.title: Dynamic Context Injection
nodes.summary: Lets users inject files, folders, or saved prompts into the agent's context mid-session with @-mentions and custom slash commands

nodes.title: Economic Value Signaling in Multi-Agent Networks
nodes.summary: Attaches a token value to inter-agent requests so recipients prioritize by value, with a peer registry for discovery and ledger settlement

nodes.title: Egress Lockdown (No-Exfiltration Channel)
nodes.summary: Puts the agent behind a default-deny egress firewall with allowlisted destinations so stolen data has no outbound channel

nodes.title: Episodic Memory Retrieval & Injection
nodes.summary: Writes a structured memory record after each episode and injects the top-k similar past memories as hints when a new task starts

nodes.title: Evidence Questions, Not Verdict Questions
nodes.summary: Never ask the model for allow/ask/block. Ask it narrow, typed, observational questions and let code reduce the answers to the verdict, because the collapsed question is the low-confidence one.

nodes.title: Evidence-Layered Evaluation for Interactive Agents
nodes.summary: Scores interactive agent runs on a task outcome assertion and links each result to layered evidence: actions, screenshots, replays, network, and messages

nodes.title: Exact-Action Authorization Binding
nodes.summary: Bind a short-lived approval to the complete action presented to the reviewer, then rederive and compare that identity at the acting boundary before execution.

nodes.title: Explicit Posterior-Sampling Planner
nodes.summary: Embeds Posterior Sampling for RL in the LLM's reasoning: sample a task model, plan, act, observe reward, and update the posterior

nodes.title: Extended Coherence Work Sessions
nodes.summary: Combines models with long coherence windows with context compaction, prompt caching, and persisted state so agents stay on task for hours

nodes.title: External Credential Sync
nodes.summary: Reads AI credentials from other tools' keychains and config files and syncs them into the agent's store, with near-expiry refresh, OAuth upgrade, and dedupe

nodes.title: Factory over Assistant
nodes.summary: Spawns several autonomous agents in parallel with automated feedback loops such as tests and builds, and checks on them later instead of watching one agent

nodes.title: Failover-Aware Model Fallback
nodes.summary: Classifies each model failure by reason and falls back along a model chain only for retryable errors, failing fast on auth, billing, and user aborts

nodes.title: Feature List as Immutable Contract
nodes.summary: Defines every feature up front in a JSON list with acceptance steps; the agent may only flip a feature to passing after it verifies it

nodes.title: Filesystem-Based Agent State
nodes.summary: Agents persist intermediate results and working state to files, creating durable checkpoints that enable workflow resumption, recovery from failures, and support for long-running tasks.

nodes.title: Filesystem-Mediated Host Delegation
nodes.summary: Lets a sandboxed agent write request files to a shared spool directory that a host daemon runs against a whitelist, with idempotent results the agent polls for

nodes.title: Frontier-Focused Development
nodes.summary: Targets only state-of-the-art models, picks the best model per use case with no user model selector, and expects to rework the product every few months

nodes.title: Graph of Thoughts (GoT)
nodes.summary: Represents reasoning as a directed graph of thoughts so the model can branch, aggregate, refine, and revisit reasoning paths

nodes.title: Hook-Based Safety Guard Rails for Autonomous Code Agents
nodes.summary: Runs small shell scripts on PreToolUse and PostToolUse hooks to block destructive commands, lint edits, and warn on context use outside the agent's reasoning

nodes.title: Human-in-the-Loop Approval Framework
nodes.summary: Systematically insert human approval gates for designated high-risk functions while maintaining agent autonomy for safe operations, with multi-channel approval interfaces and comprehensive audit trails.

nodes.title: Hybrid LLM/Code Workflow Coordinator
nodes.summary: Lets each workflow pick an LLM or a code script as its coordinator, so teams prototype with the LLM and move to reviewed code when determinism matters

nodes.title: Incident-to-Eval Synthesis
nodes.summary: Converts each production incident into executable eval cases with pass/fail criteria and gates future releases on them

nodes.title: Inference-Healed Code Review Reward
nodes.summary: Replaces a binary tests-passed reward with a critic that scores correctness, style, performance, and security, explains low scores, and combines them

nodes.title: Inference-Time Scaling
nodes.summary: Spends extra compute at inference time with best-of-N sampling, longer reasoning, self-refinement, search, and verification to improve output quality

nodes.title: Initializer-Maintainer Dual Agent Architecture
nodes.summary: Uses a one-time initializer agent to create the feature list, progress files, and bootstrap script, then a coding agent that resumes from them one feature per session

nodes.title: Intelligent Bash Tool Execution
nodes.summary: Runs agent shell commands through a multi-mode executor that uses a PTY when needed, falls back to direct exec, and manages approvals, background jobs, and signals

nodes.title: Inversion of Control
nodes.summary: Gives the agent tools, a high-level objective, and guardrails, then lets it choose sequencing and recovery while humans set policy and review

nodes.title: Isolated VM per RL Rollout
nodes.summary: Spin up an isolated virtual machine for each RL rollout to prevent cross-contamination between parallel agent executions, ensuring safe training with destructive tool access.

nodes.title: Iterative Multi-Agent Brainstorming
nodes.summary: Spawns several agents in parallel on the same problem, often with different perspectives, then merges their ideas into one set of options

nodes.title: Iterative Prompt & Skill Refinement
nodes.summary: Combines a feedback channel, editable prompt documents, log-driven skill fixes, and usage dashboards to improve agent prompts and skills continuously

nodes.title: Lane-Based Execution Queueing
nodes.summary: Routes work into named lanes, each with its own queue and concurrency limit, so sessions never interleave and background jobs never block users

nodes.title: Language Agent Tree Search (LATS)
nodes.summary: Runs Monte Carlo Tree Search over reasoning steps, with the LLM generating candidate actions and scoring partial solutions to pick the best path

nodes.title: Latent Demand Product Discovery
nodes.summary: Builds hackable, extensible products, watches how power users repurpose them, and turns the most frequent workarounds into supported features

nodes.title: Layered Configuration Context
nodes.summary: Loads context files from enterprise, user, project, and local levels automatically and merges them into the agent's baseline context

nodes.title: Lethal Trifecta Threat Model
nodes.summary: Classifies each tool by private-data access, untrusted-content exposure, and external communication, and blocks any execution path that has all three

nodes.title: LLM Map-Reduce Pattern
nodes.summary: Processes each untrusted document in its own sandboxed LLM call with a constrained output, then aggregates the results with deterministic code

nodes.title: LLM Observability
nodes.summary: Sends agent runs to an LLM observability platform for span-level traces of each LLM call and tool use, plus aggregate cost, latency, and success metrics

nodes.title: LLM-Friendly API Design
nodes.summary: Designs APIs with visible versions, self-descriptive names and schemas, simple calls, actionable errors, and few indirection levels so LLMs call them correctly

nodes.title: Local-First Credential Broker
nodes.summary: Keep raw secrets out of the agent process by injecting credentials at the network layer through a local broker, rather than handing the agent environment variables or config files.

nodes.title: Markdown Polis — Multi-Vendor Agent Coordination via Filesystem Constitution
nodes.summary: Coordinates agents from different vendors through versioned markdown files: capability cards, work contracts, and bandit routing that learns from settled work

nodes.title: MCP Pattern Injection
nodes.summary: Runs an MCP server that exposes framework best-practice patterns as tools, so the coding assistant fetches current patterns on demand

nodes.title: Memory Reinforcement Learning (MemRL)
nodes.summary: Stores memories with learned utility scores, retrieves by similarity then re-ranks by utility, and updates scores from outcomes while the LLM stays frozen

nodes.title: Memory Synthesis from Execution Logs
nodes.summary: Has the agent write a structured diary per task, then runs synthesis agents over many diaries to turn recurring patterns into rules, commands, and tests

nodes.title: Merged Code + Language Skill Model
nodes.summary: Fine-tunes separate language and code specialists from the same base model, then merges their weights into one model instead of one large joint training run

nodes.title: Milestone Escrow for Agent Resource Funding
nodes.summary: Holds agent funding in escrow and releases each payment only after independent verification of a measurable milestone

nodes.title: Multi-Model Orchestration for Complex Edits
nodes.summary: Splits complex code edits across specialized models: a retrieval model gathers context, a large model writes the changes, and smaller models apply them

nodes.title: Multi-Platform Communication Aggregation
nodes.summary: Queries every communication platform in parallel through adapters that share one schema, then merges, deduplicates, and ranks the results

nodes.title: Multi-Platform Webhook Triggers
nodes.summary: Starts agent workflows from Slack, Notion, and Jira webhooks, emoji reactions, and schedules, with idempotency and signature checks on each event

nodes.title: No-Token-Limit Magic
nodes.summary: Removes hard token limits during prototyping to learn what good behavior needs, then compresses context only after quality is stable and measured

nodes.title: Non-Custodial Spending Controls
nodes.summary: Puts a policy layer between the agent and the transaction signer that checks each intent against allowlists, budgets, and rate limits, and fails closed

nodes.title: Non-Generative Judgment Routing with Typed Escalation
nodes.summary: Sends decision-only loop steps as batched typed questions to a non-generative judgment model and escalates what it cannot answer back to the LLM

nodes.title: One OS User per Agent
nodes.summary: Give each long-lived agent its own OS user account and a templated init-system unit, so identity, supervision and privilege come from the host instead of from a per-agent container.

nodes.title: Opponent Processor / Multi-Agent Debate Pattern
nodes.summary: Spawns agents with opposing roles on the same context, lets them critique each other, then synthesizes their positions to expose bias and blind spots

nodes.title: Oracle and Worker Multi-Model Approach
nodes.summary: Uses a fast, low-cost worker model for most tool use and code generation, and lets it consult an expensive oracle model when it is stuck

nodes.title: Orchestration Prompt-Writing Benchmark
nodes.summary: Scores an orchestrator on whether its sub-agent prompts give the right information fragments to the right roles, separate from end-task success

nodes.title: Out-of-Process Provider-Boundary Replay
nodes.summary: Capture an agent run at the model-provider HTTP boundary from outside the process, then serve those bytes back so the agent re-executes its own logic with no provider call.

nodes.title: Output Verification Loop
nodes.summary: Verify LLM outputs by extracting individual claims, checking each against evidence sources, and returning per-claim trust scores before acting on the result.

nodes.title: Own-Check Fault Injection
nodes.summary: Plant a controlled fault inside a running agent pipeline and score whether the pipeline's own checks emit a detection act, keeping detected, reacted and recovered as separate verdicts.

nodes.title: Parallel Tool Call Learning
nodes.summary: Uses agent reinforcement fine-tuning to teach the model to issue independent tool calls in parallel, which cuts sequential rounds and latency

nodes.title: Patch Steering via Prompted Tool Selection
nodes.summary: Tells the agent in the prompt which patch or refactoring tool to use, with usage examples, negative rules, and a fallback order

nodes.title: Persistent Test Memory Feedback Loop
nodes.summary: Preserve validated test lessons so an agent can reuse successful paths, recognize recurring failures, and retire stale knowledge.

nodes.title: PII Tokenization
nodes.summary: Replaces PII in tool results with placeholder tokens before the model sees them and restores the real values in outgoing tool calls

nodes.title: Plan-Then-Execute Pattern
nodes.summary: Has the LLM fix the full sequence of tool calls before it reads untrusted data, then runs that sequence so tool outputs change only parameters

nodes.title: Planner-Worker Separation for Long-Running Agents
nodes.summary: Splits agents into planners that create tasks, workers that complete them in isolation, and a judge that decides each cycle whether to continue

nodes.title: Policy-Gated Tool Proxy
nodes.summary: Insert a transparent proxy between agents and tool servers that evaluates every tool call against a policy engine before forwarding, producing an immutable audit trail of all decisions.

nodes.title: Precomputed Code Graph Lookup
nodes.summary: Answer an agent's structural code questions from a precomputed, deterministic graph queried by intent-shaped verbs, instead of a retrieval-time search-and-read loop.

nodes.title: Proactive Agent State Externalization
nodes.summary: Gives agents note templates, completeness checks, and an external memory fallback so self-written notes keep objectives, decisions, and knowledge gaps

nodes.title: Proactive Trigger Vocabulary
nodes.summary: Gives each skill an explicit, documented list of trigger phrases and patterns so input routes to skills predictably, with optional proactive activation

nodes.title: Progressive Autonomy with Model Evolution
nodes.summary: Audits prompts and orchestration after each model upgrade and removes the scaffolding that evals show the new model no longer needs

nodes.title: Progressive Complexity Escalation
nodes.summary: Deploys agents on low-complexity, high-reliability tasks first and unlocks higher capability tiers when metrics and human review gates show proven reliability

nodes.title: Progressive Disclosure for Large Files
nodes.summary: Puts only file metadata in the prompt and gives the agent load, peek, and extract tools to pull file content into context on demand

nodes.title: Progressive Tool Discovery
nodes.summary: Organizes tools in a browsable hierarchy and lets the agent load names, descriptions, or full schemas only for the tools it needs

nodes.title: Prompt Caching via Exact Prefix Preservation
nodes.summary: Keeps static prompt content first in a fixed order and only appends new messages, including config changes, so each request reuses the cached prefix

nodes.title: Reasoning-Token Firewall
nodes.summary: Assemble an agent's result only from answer-typed stream events, never by string-stripping interleaved reasoning tokens.

nodes.title: Recursive Best-of-N Delegation
nodes.summary: Runs several parallel candidate workers per subtask in a recursive agent tree, scores them with tests and a judge, and promotes the best result upward

nodes.title: Reflection Loop
nodes.summary: Scores each draft against a fixed rubric, feeds the critique into a revision, and repeats until the draft passes a threshold or the retry budget ends

nodes.title: Reliability Problem Map Checklist for RAG and Agents
nodes.summary: Runs a fixed 16-question failure checklist on each RAG or agent incident, maps the result to repair actions, and re-tests the same failing case

nodes.title: Rendered UI Finish Gate
nodes.summary: Verify an agent-built interface against its intended design contract, required states, interaction semantics, and rendered output before merging.

nodes.title: Rich Feedback Loops > Perfect Prompts
nodes.summary: Returns compiler errors, test failures, lint output, and human feedback to the agent after each tool call so it can plan fixes and self-correct

nodes.title: RLAIF (Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback)
nodes.summary: Uses an AI model guided by written principles to critique outputs and label preferences, which train a reward model that optimizes the policy

nodes.title: Sandboxed Tool Authorization
nodes.summary: Filters an agent's tools through deny-first allow and deny patterns, profile presets, and subagent policies that inherit parent restrictions

nodes.title: Schema Validation Retry with Cross-Step Learning
nodes.summary: Retries failed structured outputs with the validation errors as feedback and adds recent errors from earlier steps to later prompts so mistakes do not repeat

nodes.title: Schema-Guided Graph Retrieval for Multi-Hop Reasoning
nodes.summary: Use one shared domain schema to align graph construction, schema evolution, query decomposition, and typed retrieval so multi-hop reasoning over private knowledge stays precise as domains change.

nodes.title: Seamless Background-to-Foreground Handoff
nodes.summary: Lets a user take over a background agent's unfinished work in the foreground, with the agent's branch, PR, and summaries carried over as context

nodes.title: Self-Critique Evaluator Loop
nodes.summary: Trains a judge model on its own synthetic comparisons of candidate outputs and uses it as a reward model or quality gate for the main agent

nodes.title: Self-Discover: LLM Self-Composed Reasoning Structures
nodes.summary: Has the LLM select, adapt, and compose reasoning modules into a task-specific reasoning structure, then solve the task by following that structure

nodes.title: Self-Identity Accumulation
nodes.summary: Injects a persistent identity document at session start and updates it with new user insights at session end through lifecycle hooks

nodes.title: Self-Rewriting Meta-Prompt Loop
nodes.summary: Has the agent reflect after each episode, draft edits to its own system prompt, validate them through guardrails, and save the new version

nodes.title: Semantic Context Filtering Pattern
nodes.summary: Extracts only the semantic or interactive parts of raw data, such as accessibility trees or relevant fields, before sending it to the LLM

nodes.title: Session-Scoped Context Runtime for Agent Tools
nodes.summary: Interpose a context runtime that caches structured reads and normalizes tool output so sessions reuse compact representations instead of repeating raw tokens.

nodes.title: Shell Command Contextualization
nodes.summary: Lets the user run a shell command with a prefix such as ! and injects the command and its full output into the agent's context

nodes.title: Shipping as Research
nodes.summary: Releases reversible, instrumented features to learn whether they work, then doubles down or removes them based on usage data and feedback

nodes.title: Signal-Driven Agent Activation
nodes.summary: Watches external sources for structured signals and starts predefined agent workflows when declarative rules with thresholds and cooldowns match

nodes.title: Skill Activation as a Precision/Recall Measurement
nodes.summary: Measures skill routing as classification with a labelled prompt dataset, per-skill precision and recall, and CI thresholds that fail the build

nodes.title: Skill Library Evolution
nodes.summary: Saves working agent code as reusable skills in a skills directory, documents and tests them over time, and loads skill details only on demand

nodes.title: Soulbound Identity Verification
nodes.summary: Binds agent identity to a non-transferable credential with a committed state hash and logs signed state changes so verifiers can check continuity

nodes.title: Spec-As-Test Feedback Loop
nodes.summary: Generates executable tests from the spec on every spec or code commit and opens agent PRs that fix code or flag unclear spec parts

nodes.title: Specification-Driven Agent Development
nodes.summary: Makes a version-controlled spec file the agent's main input, scaffolds code from it, and links each artifact back to a spec clause

nodes.title: Spectrum of Control / Blended Initiative
nodes.summary: Gives users several autonomy modes, from inline completion to background agents, and lets them switch modes per task

nodes.title: Static Service Manifest for Agents
nodes.summary: Serves a static llms.txt or agent.json file at a well-known URL that lists services, auth, and limits so agents can plan before they call

nodes.title: Stop Hook Auto-Continue Pattern
nodes.summary: Runs a stop hook after each agent turn that checks success criteria and makes the agent continue until tests or checks pass

nodes.title: Structured Output Specification
nodes.summary: Constrain agent outputs using deterministic schemas that enforce structured, machine-readable results, enabling reliable validation, parsing, and integration with downstream systems.

nodes.title: Sub-Agent Spawning
nodes.summary: Lets the main agent spawn sub-agents with fresh context and scoped tools to work on subtasks in parallel, then merges their results

nodes.title: Subagent Compilation Checker
nodes.summary: Spawns one subagent per module to build and check it, and returns only a short structured error list or artifact reference to the main agent

nodes.title: Subject Hygiene for Task Delegation
nodes.summary: Requires a specific action-plus-target subject on every subagent task so each delegated job stays traceable and easy to reference

nodes.title: Surface-Scoped System Prompt
nodes.summary: Ships one system prompt per invocation surface and selects it at launch, so an interactive session, a headless run and a task mode each get instructions written for that surface

nodes.title: Swarm Migration Pattern
nodes.summary: Main agent orchestrates 10+ parallel subagents working simultaneously on independent migration chunks, achieving 10x+ speedup for large-scale framework upgrades, lint rule rollouts, and API migrations.

nodes.title: Team-Shared Agent Configuration as Code
nodes.summary: Check agent configuration into version control as code, enabling consistent behavior across teams, faster onboarding, and collaborative improvement through PRs and code review.

nodes.title: Three-Stage Perception Architecture
nodes.summary: Splits the agent into separate perception, processing, and action stages so each stage can be built, tested, and scaled on its own

nodes.title: Tier Auto-Apply by Mechanical Impact
nodes.summary: Decides which self-proposed changes auto-apply by matching the real diff's file paths and change kinds against a trusted tier table, not by finding text

nodes.title: Tool Capability Compartmentalization
nodes.summary: Splits tools into reader, processor, and writer classes with scoped permissions and blocks tool chains that combine private data, untrusted input, and external writes

nodes.title: Tool Search Lazy Loading
nodes.summary: Dynamically load tools via search instead of preloading all available tools to reduce context usage

nodes.title: Tool Selection Guide
nodes.summary: Maps each task type to a preferred tool: Glob, Grep, and Read to explore, Edit to modify, Bash to verify, and Task with a clear subject to delegate

nodes.title: Tool Use Incentivization via Reward Shaping
nodes.summary: Gives dense RL rewards for useful intermediate tool calls such as compile, lint, and test so the agent learns to use tools instead of only thinking

nodes.title: Tool Use Steering via Prompting
nodes.summary: Tells the agent in the prompt which tool to use, how to learn a custom tool, and which shorthands map to tool sequences

nodes.title: Tracker-as-Desired-State Reconciliation
nodes.summary: Derive agent dispatch by re-reading workflow states in the team's issue tracker every tick, keeping only a short-lived claim locally, so missed events, restarts, and human edits all self-heal.

nodes.title: Transitive Vouch-Chain Trust
nodes.summary: Builds a graph of signed vouches between agents and derives trust in an unknown agent from the chain back to a trusted one, with decay at each hop

nodes.title: Tree-of-Thought Reasoning
nodes.summary: Expands a tree of candidate reasoning steps, scores partial states, prunes weak branches, and picks the best path instead of one linear chain

nodes.title: Unified Tool Gateway
nodes.summary: Route all agent tool calls through a single gateway that handles discovery, authentication, billing, and execution across many heterogeneous providers.

nodes.title: Variance-Based RL Sample Selection
nodes.summary: Runs the base model several times per sample and trains RL only on samples with score variance, skipping ones that are always right or always wrong

nodes.title: Verbose Reasoning Transparency
nodes.summary: Lets users open a verbose view on demand that shows the agent's interpretation, tool choices, intermediate steps, and raw tool outputs

nodes.title: Versioned Constitution Governance
nodes.summary: Stores the agent constitution in a signed Git repository where the agent can only propose changes and reviewers or CI gates merge them

nodes.title: Virtual Machine Operator Agent
nodes.summary: Gives the agent a dedicated virtual machine where it can run code, install packages, use the file system, and operate CLI tools

nodes.title: Visual AI Multimodal Integration
nodes.summary: Adds multimodal models to the agent so it can analyze images, video, and screenshots and combine them with text to reason and act

nodes.title: Workflow Evals with Mocked Tools
nodes.summary: Runs complete agent workflows against mocked tools in CI and checks which tools were called plus agent-as-judge quality criteria

nodes.title: Working Memory via TodoWrite
nodes.summary: Keeps an explicit todo list with status, blockers, and next steps during the session so agent and user can track progress

nodes.title: Workspace-Native Multi-Agent Orchestration
nodes.summary: Runs agents inside the team's workspace platform so they share its memory, knowledge sources, event triggers, and integrations with humans

nodes.title: Zero-Knowledge Verified Agent Egress
nodes.summary: Intercepts each outbound HTTP or MCP call, proves its claims against a private source of truth with a zero-knowledge proof, and blocks calls that fail

nodes.title: Zero-Trust Agent Mesh
nodes.summary: Gives each agent a cryptographic identity and verifies identity, signed delegation tokens, and chain depth on every inter-agent request
